messages:
mira: Heads-up: BigCorp signed the pilot LOE. They expect SSO + provisioning for pilot. They asked for a firm week.

ben: Two options: 1) SAML-only pilot + manual provisioning (fast) 2) SAML+SCIM automated provisioning but pilot delayed. Rough eng: SAML ~1 sprint, SCIM minimal ~3w.

kai: Security note: audit logs required for provisioning. Adding audit hooks is small (~2d) but needs QA.

rachel: Customer ops: manual provisioning will add friction; BigCorp metric is "seats populated within 48h". Manual could work if we commit an ops rota.

sam: Ops can run a scripted onboarding for 1-2 pilot customers. We'll need a clear runbook and SLAs for completion.

mira: Tradeoffs: speed vs automation. Proposal: SAML-only pilot, ops-run onboarding, commit to SCIM + audit logs for v1. Milestones: pilot start in 2w, v1 GA in 8w.

ben: Risks: shipping minimal SCIM later means a busier v1 sprint. Also SCIM without full regression coverage increases support load.

kai: QA: recommend staged pilot (one BU at a time) to reduce blast radius; will add extra audit checks.

rachel: I'll confirm with BigCorp that manual onboarding is acceptable for the initial cohort and set expectations around 48h SLA.

sam: I'll write the runbook and schedule oncall for the first 4 weeks.

mira: Actions: rachel update BigCorp (today); sam publish runbook (48h); ben update PRD + backlog (EOD); calendar-bot: create milestone meeting Friday 10am.

calendar-bot: "Event created: Pilot scope check-in — Friday 10:00"

mira: Marking resolved unless BigCorp pushes for automation before pilot start. :thumbsup:
